scene.coordinate_axes: +Z up, +X away from long artwork wall, +Y toward end windows
scene.coordinate_origin: Intersection of the leveled artwork-wall datum and floor in the transverse plane through the first tracked camera center.
scene.frame_mapping: Ascending, zero-based source frames. Blender frame = source frame + 1.
scene.scale_assumption: Dining tabletop is assumed 0.75 m above the floor. All reported length estimates scale uniformly.
scene.dimension_convention: XYZ extents along each object’s modeled local axes, with the world scale of those axes applied. World-authored geometry uses room axes. Values describe the named component. World-axis-aligned bbox_m comes from evaluated vertices on source frame 0. Compound extents include descendant components in assembly_bbox_m. Numeric storage precision does not imply measurement accuracy.
scene.visibility_convention: first_observed_frame is the estimated first identifiable source view, often assigned by component group. Occluded construction inherits its parent observation. Some camera-frustum appearances precede identification.
scene.motion: No rigid furniture or prop motion identified. Camera animated throughout. Ember illumination varies procedurally.
